text: Yes, about 0.7 hectares (1.2% of the property) of tree cover was lost in 2023. This was confirmed by satellite data, showing the area was forested in 2020. However, we don’t know why the trees were removed—it could have been logging, a fire, or another reason. The change was small, and we can’t say if it was legal or who did it. The rest of the 58-hectare property remained forested.
